metadata.guideline_source: Hand-curated from general primary-care/ED triage patterns (Centor criteria for pharyngitis, classic renal colic/UTI differential, chest-pain safety-netting) — paraphrased, general medical knowledge, not a transcription of any single named guideline
metadata.note: Expanded from 7 to 17 illustrative diseases for a course prototype — broader coverage of common primary-care and can't-miss ED presentations, but still hand-curated general medical knowledge, NOT a licensed/versioned clinical guideline. Replace with a real source before any real-world use. The fabricated-looking guideline_version string is intentional — it demonstrates the versioning field the architecture calls for without falsely claiming a specific real citation.

diseases.name: pharyngitis
diseases.note: Loosely modeled on Centor criteria — absence of cough is itself a positive signal toward strep-pattern pharyngitis, hence 'cough' as contraindicating rather than merely absent-from-supporting.

diseases.name: migraine
diseases.note: Deliberately overlaps with tension_headache on the same required symptom — the supporting/contraindicating sets are what should separate them, which is exactly the kind of gap the Planner should target.

diseases.name: gerd
diseases.note: Chest discomfort from reflux is a classic cardiac mimic — contraindicating on true chest_pain/shortness_of_breath keeps this from ever outscoring the ACS/PE/panic-attack cluster below, which is the clinically correct default when the two are hard to tell apart from symptoms alone.

diseases.name: pyelonephritis
diseases.red_flag_reason: risk of urosepsis if untreated — the escalated variant of a UTI/kidney-stone-pattern presentation

diseases.name: acute_coronary_syndrome
diseases.red_flag_reason: chest pain + breathlessness is a hard emergency short-circuit (architecture doc §9)

diseases.name: pulmonary_embolism
diseases.red_flag_reason: life-threatening and cannot be distinguished from ACS by symptoms alone — shares the hard chest_pain+shortness_of_breath short-circuit by design

diseases.name: anxiety_panic_attack
diseases.note: Intentionally shares its required symptoms with acute_coronary_syndrome and pulmonary_embolism. This candidate is NOT individually marked red_flag, but the hard chest_pain+shortness_of_breath rule-engine combination (rules/rule_engine.py) fires regardless of which of the three wins — a real self-assessment tool should never let 'probably just anxiety' suppress an emergency-level response to this symptom pattern, and this KB entry exists specifically to prove that design holds.

diseases.name: allergic_reaction_anaphylaxis
diseases.red_flag_reason: anaphylaxis can be fatal within minutes

diseases.name: stroke
diseases.red_flag_reason: stroke-pattern symptoms short-circuit straight to Level 3 (architecture doc §9)
